headline.zh: 可俯瞰复旦校园的多层咖啡厅
headline.en: Multi-level café with views over Fudan University

traits.en: Offers views overlooking Fudan University campus

traits.zh: 多层开放式空间，含二楼座位区
traits.en: Multi-level open space with a second-floor seating area

traits.zh: 大面积落地玻璃窗，采光良好
traits.en: Large floor-to-ceiling windows providing ample natural light

traits.zh: 供应简餐、三明治、意大利面、披萨
traits.en: Serves light meals including sandwiches, pasta, and pizza

focus.zh: 适合同学聚会，但中庭活动影响安静
focus.en: Suitable for group study, but ground-floor atrium events disrupt quiet

energy.zh: 楼下中庭活动会影响安静环境
energy.en: Ground-floor atrium events increase ambient noise

linger.zh: 多层空间+较多座位+供应简餐
linger.en: Multi-level layout, ample seating, and meal service support long stays

adventure.zh: 供应咖啡、茶水及常规简餐
adventure.en: Serves standard coffee, tea, and conventional light meals
